{{Quest|Further Investigating Jake}} |location = [[Desert Settlement]] |location_page_description = Has suspicious about {{NPCSprite|Jake}}. |x = 163.5 |y = 77 |z = -359 |location2 = [[Underground Lab]] |location_page_description2 = Appears here after the player has accepted {{Green|4}} of their visiting offers on {{Zone|The Garden}}. |x2 = 174.5 |y2 = 26 |z2 = -477 |location3 = [[Underground Lab]] |location_page_description3 = Appears here after the player has accepted {{Green|5}} of their visiting offers on {{Zone|The Garden}}. |x3 = 173.875 |y3 = 28 |z3 = -498.5 |location4 = [[Underground Lab]] |location_page_description4 = Appears here after the player presses the lever in the first room of the lab, and before moving around to explore this second room. |x4 = 190.5 |y4 = 22 |z4 = -499.5 }} '''Beth''' is an [[NPC]] located in the {{zone|Desert Settlement}}. She has a quest involving {{NPCSprite|Jake}}, where she and the player explore the {{Zone|Underground Lab}} and uncover {{NPCSprite|Jake}}'s secrets. The first visit there unlocks {{Item|Jake's Plushie}}, and the second visit, which requires unlocking the [[Greenhouse]] first, grants access to the [[Crop Analyzer]]. __TOC__ == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable" ! colspan="2" | Condition !
